theory RSF_Zig_Verification
  imports Main "HOL-Library.Word"
begin

section \<open>Zig Error Types and IEEE-754 Abstraction\<close>

datatype zig_err = 
    InvalidDimension 
  | InvalidLayerCount 
  | TooLarge 
  | NonFinite 
  | InvalidConfig 
  | ShapeMismatch 
  | DataLengthMismatch 
  | NotInitialized 
  | NumericFailure 
  | BadFileFormat 
  | UnsupportedVersion 
  | OutOfMemory

text \<open>Abstract Model of IEEE-754 f32 using 32-bit words\<close>

type_synonym f32 = "32 word"

consts
  f32_zero :: f32
  f32_one :: f32
  f32_add :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_sub :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_mul :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_div :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_exp :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_is_finite :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  f32_lt :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  f32_eq :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  float_of_f32 :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> real"
  f32_of_float :: "real \<Rightarrow> f32"

specification (f32_ops)
  f32_finite_zero: "f32_is_finite f32_zero"
  f32_finite_one: "f32_is_finite f32_one"
  f32_add_comm: "f32_add a b = f32_add b a"
  f32_of_float_inv: "\<forall>x. f32_is_finite x \<longrightarrow> f32_of_float (float_of_f32 x) = x"
  by (auto)

definition f32_clamp_finite :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "f32_clamp_finite x = (if f32_is_finite x then x else f32_zero)"

definition f32_clip :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "f32_clip x min_v max_v = (if f32_lt x min_v then min_v else if f32_lt max_v x then max_v else x)"

section \<open>Memory Model and Monad\<close>

text \<open>We define a heap to model Zig pointers and in-place mutation.\<close>

type_synonym addr = nat

record tensor_struct =
  t_dims :: "nat list"
  t_data :: "f32 list"

definition valid_tensor :: "tensor_struct \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "valid_tensor t \<longleftrightarrow> length (t_dims t) = 2 \<and> length (t_data t) = (t_dims t ! 0) * (t_dims t ! 1)"

datatype heap_val = 
    ValTensor tensor_struct 
  | ValU32 nat
  | ValFreed

type_synonym heap = "addr \<Rightarrow> heap_val option"

datatype 'a res = Ok 'a | Err zig_err

type_synonym 'a M = "heap \<Rightarrow> ('a \<times> heap) res"

definition return :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a M" where
  "return x h = Ok (x, h)"

definition bind :: "'a M \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b M) \<Rightarrow> 'b M" (infixl ">>=" 54) where
  "bind m f h = (case m h of Ok (x, h') \<Rightarrow> f x h' | Err e \<Rightarrow> Err e)"

definition fail :: "zig_err \<Rightarrow> 'a M" where
  "fail e h = Err e"

definition get_heap :: "heap M" where
  "get_heap h = Ok (h, h)"

definition put_heap :: "heap \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "put_heap h' h = Ok ((), h')"

definition alloc :: "heap_val \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "alloc v h = (let next_addr = (LEAST a. h a = None) in 
                if h next_addr = None then Ok (next_addr, h(next_addr \<mapsto> v)) else Err OutOfMemory)"

definition free :: "addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "free p h = (if h p = None then Err NotInitialized else Ok ((), h(p := Some ValFreed)))"

definition load_tensor :: "addr \<Rightarrow> tensor_struct M" where
  "load_tensor p h = (case h p of Some (ValTensor t) \<Rightarrow> Ok (t, h) | _ \<Rightarrow> Err NotInitialized)"

definition store_tensor :: "addr \<Rightarrow> tensor_struct \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "store_tensor p t h = (if h p = None then Err NotInitialized else Ok ((), h(p \<mapsto> ValTensor t)))"

definition assert_true :: "bool \<Rightarrow> zig_err \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "assert_true b e = (if b then return () else fail e)"

section \<open>Tensor Operations Specification\<close>

definition tensor_zeros :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "tensor_zeros dims = (
    if length dims \<noteq> 2 then fail ShapeMismatch else
    let size = (dims!0) * (dims!1) in
    alloc (ValTensor \<lparr> t_dims = dims, t_data = replicate size f32_zero \<rparr>))"

definition tensor_copy :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "tensor_copy p = (
     load_tensor p >>= (\<lambda>t.
     alloc (ValTensor t)))"

definition assert2DAndLen :: "tensor_struct \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "assert2DAndLen t = (
     if length (t_dims t) \<noteq> 2 then fail ShapeMismatch
     else if length (t_data t) \<noteq> (t_dims t!0) * (t_dims t!1) then fail DataLengthMismatch
     else return ())"

definition get_rows_cols :: "tensor_struct \<Rightarrow> (nat \<times> nat) M" where
  "get_rows_cols t = (
     assert2DAndLen t >>= (\<lambda>_.
     return (t_dims t ! 0, t_dims t ! 1)))"

text \<open>Implementation of Row-Major Indexing\<close>
definition idx :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "idx r c cols = r * cols + c"

definition transpose_data :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> f32 list" where
  "transpose_data rows cols d = map (\<lambda>i. d ! (idx (i mod cols) (i div cols) rows)) [0..<rows*cols]"

definition tensor_transpose :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "tensor_transpose p = (
     load_tensor p >>= (\<lambda>t.
     get_rows_cols t >>= (\<lambda>(rows, cols).
     let new_dims = [cols, rows] in
     let new_data = transpose_data rows cols (t_data t) in
     alloc (ValTensor \<lparr> t_dims = new_dims, t_data = new_data \<rparr>))))"

definition matmul_data :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> f32 list" where
  "matmul_data r1 c1 c2 d1 d2 = 
    [ foldl f32_add f32_zero 
      [ f32_mul (d1 ! (idx i k c1)) (d2 ! (idx k j c2)) . k \<leftarrow> [0..<c1] ] 
      . i \<leftarrow> [0..<r1], j \<leftarrow> [0..<c2] ]"

definition tensor_matmul :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "tensor_matmul p1 p2 = (
     load_tensor p1 >>= (\<lambda>t1.
     load_tensor p2 >>= (\<lambda>t2.
     get_rows_cols t1 >>= (\<lambda>(r1, c1).
     get_rows_cols t2 >>= (\<lambda>(r2, c2).
     assert_true (c1 = r2) ShapeMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let new_data = matmul_data r1 c1 c2 (t_data t1) (t_data t2) in
     alloc (ValTensor \<lparr> t_dims = [r1, c2], t_data = new_data \<rparr>))))))"

section \<open>In-Place Operations Specification\<close>

definition in_place_map :: "addr \<Rightarrow> (f32 \<Rightarrow> f32) \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "in_place_map p f = (
     load_tensor p >>= (\<lambda>t.
     let new_data = map f (t_data t) in
     store_tensor p (t \<lparr> t_data := new_data \<rparr>)))"

definition in_place_map2 :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> (f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32) \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "in_place_map2 p1 p2 f = (
     load_tensor p1 >>= (\<lambda>t1.
     load_tensor p2 >>= (\<lambda>t2.
     assert2DAndLen t1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert2DAndLen t2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert_true (length (t_data t1) = length (t_data t2)) DataLengthMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let new_data = map (\<lambda>(a,b). f a b) (zip (t_data t1) (t_data t2)) in
     store_tensor p1 (t1 \<lparr> t_data := new_data \<rparr>))))))"

definition clamp_finite_in_place :: "addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "clamp_finite_in_place p = in_place_map p f32_clamp_finite"

definition tensor_clip :: "addr \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_clip p min_v max_v = in_place_map p (\<lambda>x. f32_clip x min_v max_v)"

definition tensor_exp :: "addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_exp p = in_place_map p f32_exp"

definition tensor_add :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_add p1 p2 = in_place_map2 p1 p2 f32_add"

definition tensor_sub :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_sub p1 p2 = in_place_map2 p1 p2 f32_sub"

definition tensor_div :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_div p1 p2 = (
     load_tensor p2 >>= (\<lambda>t2.
     if \<exists>x \<in> set (t_data t2). \<not> f32_is_finite x \<or> f32_eq x f32_zero then fail NumericFailure
     else in_place_map2 p1 p2 f32_div))"

section \<open>RSF Layer Logic\<close>

record rsf_layer_struct =
  s_weight :: addr
  t_weight :: addr
  s_bias :: addr
  t_bias :: addr
  s_weight_grad :: addr
  t_weight_grad :: addr
  s_bias_grad :: addr
  t_bias_grad :: addr
  dim :: nat
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool

definition add_bias_broadcast :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "add_bias_broadcast p_mat p_bias dim = (
     load_tensor p_mat >>= (\<lambda>t_m.
     load_tensor p_bias >>= (\<lambda>t_b.
     let d_m = t_data t_m in
     let d_b = t_data t_b in
     let new_data = map_index (\<lambda>i x. f32_add x (d_b ! (i mod dim))) d_m in
     store_tensor p_mat (t_m \<lparr> t_data := new_data \<rparr>))))"

definition assert_pair :: "rsf_layer_struct \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> nat M" where
  "assert_pair self a b = (
     load_tensor a >>= (\<lambda>ta.
     load_tensor b >>= (\<lambda>tb.
     assert2DAndLen ta >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert2DAndLen tb >>= (\<lambda>_.
     if t_dims ta ! 1 \<noteq> dim self \<or> t_dims tb ! 1 \<noteq> dim self then fail ShapeMismatch
     else if t_dims ta ! 0 \<noteq> t_dims tb ! 0 then fail ShapeMismatch
     else if \<not> f32_lt (clip_min self) (clip_max self) then fail InvalidConfig
     else return (t_dims ta ! 0)))))"

definition rsf_layer_forward :: "rsf_layer_struct \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_layer_forward self x1 x2 = (
     assert_pair self x1 x2 >>= (\<lambda>batch_size.
     
     tensor_transpose x2 >>= (\<lambda>x2_t.
     tensor_matmul (s_weight self) x2_t >>= (\<lambda>s_x2_t.
     tensor_transpose s_x2_t >>= (\<lambda>s_x2.
     
     add_bias_broadcast s_x2 (s_bias self) (dim self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     clamp_finite_in_place s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_clip s_x2 (clip_min self) (clip_max self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_exp s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     in_place_map2 x1 s_x2 f32_mul >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     tensor_transpose x1 >>= (\<lambda>x1_t.
     tensor_matmul (t_weight self) x1_t >>= (\<lambda>t_x1_t.
     tensor_transpose t_x1_t >>= (\<lambda>t_x1.
     
     add_bias_broadcast t_x1 (t_bias self) (dim self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     clamp_finite_in_place t_x1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_add x2 t_x1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     free x2_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free s_x2_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     free x1_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free t_x1_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free t_x1)))))))))))))))))))))"

definition rsf_layer_inverse :: "rsf_layer_struct \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse self y1 y2 = (
     assert_pair self y1 y2 >>= (\<lambda>batch_size.
     
     tensor_transpose y1 >>= (\<lambda>y1_t.
     tensor_matmul (t_weight self) y1_t >>= (\<lambda>t_y1_t.
     tensor_transpose t_y1_t >>= (\<lambda>t_y1.
     add_bias_broadcast t_y1 (t_bias self) (dim self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place t_y1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_sub y2 t_y1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     tensor_transpose y2 >>= (\<lambda>y2_t.
     tensor_matmul (s_weight self) y2_t >>= (\<lambda>s_y2_t.
     tensor_transpose s_y2_t >>= (\<lambda>s_y2.
     add_bias_broadcast s_y2 (s_bias self) (dim self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_clip s_y2 (clip_min self) (clip_max self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_exp s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     tensor_div y1 s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place y1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     (* Cleanup *)
     free y1_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free t_y1_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free t_y1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     free y2_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free s_y2_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free s_y2)))))))))))))))))))))"

section \<open>RSF Network Logic\<close>

record rsf_config =
  cfg_clip_min :: f32
  cfg_clip_max :: f32
  cfg_grad_mean :: bool
  max_dim :: nat
  max_layers :: nat

record rsf_network =
  ctrl_dim :: nat
  ctrl_layers :: "rsf_layer_struct list"
  ctrl_config :: rsf_config
  ctrl_freed :: bool

definition rsf_split :: "rsf_network \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_split net x x1 x2 = (
     load_tensor x >>= (\<lambda>tx.
     assert2DAndLen tx >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert_true (t_dims tx ! 1 = ctrl_dim net * 2) ShapeMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let batch = t_dims tx ! 0 in
     let d = ctrl_dim net in
     load_tensor x1 >>= (\<lambda>tx1.
     load_tensor x2 >>= (\<lambda>tx2.
     assert_true (t_dims tx1 = [batch, d] \<and> t_dims tx2 = [batch, d]) ShapeMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let data = t_data tx in
     let d1 = map (\<lambda>i. data ! (i div d * 2 * d + i mod d)) [0..<batch*d] in
     let d2 = map (\<lambda>i. data ! (i div d * 2 * d + d + i mod d)) [0..<batch*d] in
     store_tensor x1 (tx1 \<lparr> t_data := d1 \<rparr>) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     store_tensor x2 (tx2 \<lparr> t_data := d2 \<rparr>))))))))"

definition rsf_merge :: "rsf_network \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_merge net x1 x2 out = (
     load_tensor x1 >>= (\<lambda>t1.
     load_tensor x2 >>= (\<lambda>t2.
     load_tensor out >>= (\<lambda>tout.
     assert2DAndLen t1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert2DAndLen t2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert2DAndLen tout >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let batch = t_dims t1 ! 0 in
     let d = ctrl_dim net in
     assert_true (t_dims t2 = [batch, d] \<and> t_dims tout = [batch, 2*d]) ShapeMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let d1 = t_data t1 in
     let d2 = t_data t2 in
     let new_data = map (\<lambda>i. if (i mod (2*d)) < d then d1 ! (i div (2*d) * d + i mod (2*d))
                             else d2 ! (i div (2*d) * d + (i mod (2*d) - d))) [0..<batch*2*d] in
     store_tensor out (tout \<lparr> t_data := new_data \<rparr>))))))))"

definition rsf_forward :: "rsf_network \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_forward net x = (
     if ctrl_freed net then fail NotInitialized else
     load_tensor x >>= (\<lambda>tx.
     assert2DAndLen tx >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let batch = t_dims tx ! 0 in
     let d = ctrl_dim net in
     tensor_zeros [batch, d] >>= (\<lambda>x1.
     tensor_zeros [batch, d] >>= (\<lambda>x2.
     rsf_split net x x1 x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     foldl (\<lambda>m layer. m >>= (\<lambda>_. rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2)) (return ()) (ctrl_layers net) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     rsf_merge net x1 x2 x >>= (\<lambda>_.
     free x1 >>= (\<lambda>_. free x2))))))))"

definition rsf_inverse :: "rsf_network \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_inverse net y = (
     if ctrl_freed net then fail NotInitialized else
     load_tensor y >>= (\<lambda>ty.
     assert2DAndLen ty >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let batch = t_dims ty ! 0 in
     let d = ctrl_dim net in
     tensor_zeros [batch, d] >>= (\<lambda>y1.
     tensor_zeros [batch, d] >>= (\<lambda>y2.
     rsf_split net y y1 y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     foldr (\<lambda>layer m. m >>= (\<lambda>_. rsf_layer_inverse layer y1 y2)) (ctrl_layers net) (return ()) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     rsf_merge net y1 y2 y >>= (\<lambda>_.
     free y1 >>= (\<lambda>_. free y2))))))))"

section \<open>File I/O and Serialization\<close>

text \<open>Byte-level serialization format: "RSF0" magic, little-endian integers.\<close>

definition magic_bytes :: "8 word list" where
  "magic_bytes = [0x52, 0x53, 0x46, 0x30]" (* RSF0 *)

definition u32_to_bytes :: "32 word \<Rightarrow> 8 word list" where
  "u32_to_bytes w = [ucast w, ucast (w >> 8), ucast (w >> 16), ucast (w >> 24)]"

definition u64_to_bytes :: "64 word \<Rightarrow> 8 word list" where
  "u64_to_bytes w = [ucast w, ucast (w >> 8), ucast (w >> 16), ucast (w >> 24),
                     ucast (w >> 32), ucast (w >> 40), ucast (w >> 48), ucast (w >> 56)]"

definition f32_to_bytes :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> 8 word list" where
  "f32_to_bytes f = u32_to_bytes f"

definition save_layer :: "rsf_layer_struct \<Rightarrow> heap \<Rightarrow> 8 word list M" where
  "save_layer l h = (
     load_tensor (s_weight l) h >>= (\<lambda>(tw, _).
     let bytes = u32_to_bytes (ucast (dim l)) in (* Simplified for brevity *)
     return bytes))" (* Note: In real verification we would serialize all fields *)

section \<open>Verification Theorems\<close>

text \<open>Proof that tensor operations preserve 2D shape invariant.\<close>
lemma tensor_transpose_preserves_validity:
  "valid_tensor t \<Longrightarrow> valid_tensor \<lparr> t_dims = [t_dims t ! 1, t_dims t ! 0], t_data = transpose_data (t_dims t ! 0) (t_dims t ! 1) (t_data t) \<rparr>"
  unfolding valid_tensor_def transpose_data_def
  by (simp add: length_concat length_map map_replicate_const)

lemma tensor_matmul_validity:
  assumes "valid_tensor t1" "valid_tensor t2"
  assumes "t_dims t1 ! 1 = t_dims t2 ! 0"
  shows "valid_tensor \<lparr> t_dims = [t_dims t1 ! 0, t_dims t2 ! 1], t_data = matmul_data (t_dims t1 ! 0) (t_dims t1 ! 1) (t_dims t2 ! 1) (t_data t1) (t_data t2) \<rparr>"
  using assms unfolding valid_tensor_def matmul_data_def
  by (simp add: length_concat length_map map_replicate_const)

text \<open>Safe Execution Proof: Forward never panics given valid inputs and memory.\<close>

lemma rsf_layer_forward_safety:
  assumes "valid_tensor t1" "valid_tensor t2"
  assumes "t_dims t1 = [batch, dim]" "t_dims t2 = [batch, dim]"
  shows "\<exists>h' res. rsf_layer_forward l p1 p2 h = Ok (res, h')"
proof -
  (* This proof sketch demonstrates that the monadic chain propagates Success 
     because all pre-conditions (shapes) are checked by assertions. 
     Isabelle would require unfolding all definitions and proving subgoals for each bind. *)
  show ?thesis
    oops

text \<open>Correctness of Split/Merge Composition\<close>

lemma split_merge_inverse:
  assumes "length data = batch * d * 2"
  shows "let d1 = map (\<lambda>i. data ! (i div d * 2 * d + i mod d)) [0..<batch*d] in
         let d2 = map (\<lambda>i. data ! (i div d * 2 * d + d + i mod d)) [0..<batch*d] in
         map (\<lambda>i. if (i mod (2*d)) < d then d1 ! (i div (2*d) * d + i mod (2*d))
                  else d2 ! (i div (2*d) * d + (i mod (2*d) - d))) [0..<batch*2*d] = data"
proof -
  (* This requires arithmetic on indices proving the permutation is identity *)
  have "\<forall>i < batch*2*d. (if (i mod (2*d)) < d then 
          (data ! ((i div (2*d) * d + i mod (2*d)) div d * 2 * d + (i div (2*d) * d + i mod (2*d)) mod d))
          else data ! ((i div (2*d) * d + (i mod (2*d) - d)) div d * 2 * d + d + (i div (2*d) * d + (i mod (2*d) - d)) mod d)) = data ! i"
    by auto
  thus ?thesis by (rule nth_equalityI, simp_all add: assms)
qed

section \<open>Main Theorem\<close>

theorem rsf_full_compliance:
  "True"
  (* 
    Theorem: The Isabelle formalization above covers:
    1. The exact Error types of Zig (zig_err).
    2. The Monadic State (Heap) handling checks like NotInitialized.
    3. The F32 IEEE semantics via axiomatization and clamping logic.
    4. The exact logic of forward/inverse/backward including memory management (free).
    5. The shape validation logic (assert2DAndLen).
    
    Therefore, any Zig implementation satisfying this model is verifiably correct
    with respect to the memory safety and shape constraints.
  *)
  by simp

end

theory RSF_Zig_Verification
  imports Main "HOL-Library.Word"
begin

section \<open>Zig Error Types and IEEE-754 Abstraction\<close>

datatype zig_err = 
    InvalidDimension 
  | InvalidLayerCount 
  | TooLarge 
  | NonFinite 
  | InvalidConfig 
  | ShapeMismatch 
  | DataLengthMismatch 
  | NotInitialized 
  | NumericFailure 
  | BadFileFormat 
  | UnsupportedVersion 
  | OutOfMemory

text \<open>Abstract Model of IEEE-754 f32 using 32-bit words\<close>

type_synonym f32 = "32 word"

consts
  f32_zero :: f32
  f32_one :: f32
  f32_add :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_sub :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_mul :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_div :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_exp :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32"
  f32_is_finite :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  f32_lt :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  f32_eq :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> bool"
  float_of_f32 :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> real"
  f32_of_float :: "real \<Rightarrow> f32"

specification (f32_ops)
  f32_finite_zero: "f32_is_finite f32_zero"
  f32_finite_one: "f32_is_finite f32_one"
  f32_add_comm: "f32_add a b = f32_add b a"
  f32_of_float_inv: "\<forall>x. f32_is_finite x \<longrightarrow> f32_of_float (float_of_f32 x) = x"
  by (auto)

definition f32_clamp_finite :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "f32_clamp_finite x = (if f32_is_finite x then x else f32_zero)"

definition f32_clip :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "f32_clip x min_v max_v = (if f32_lt x min_v then min_v else if f32_lt max_v x then max_v else x)"

section \<open>Memory Model and Monad\<close>

text \<open>We define a heap to model Zig pointers and in-place mutation.\<close>

type_synonym addr = nat

record tensor_struct =
  t_dims :: "nat list"
  t_data :: "f32 list"

definition valid_tensor :: "tensor_struct \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "valid_tensor t \<longleftrightarrow> length (t_dims t) = 2 \<and> length (t_data t) = (t_dims t ! 0) * (t_dims t ! 1)"

datatype heap_val = 
    ValTensor tensor_struct 
  | ValU32 nat
  | ValFreed

type_synonym heap = "addr \<Rightarrow> heap_val option"

datatype 'a res = Ok 'a | Err zig_err

type_synonym 'a M = "heap \<Rightarrow> ('a \<times> heap) res"

definition return :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a M" where
  "return x h = Ok (x, h)"

definition bind :: "'a M \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b M) \<Rightarrow> 'b M" (infixl ">>=" 54) where
  "bind m f h = (case m h of Ok (x, h') \<Rightarrow> f x h' | Err e \<Rightarrow> Err e)"

definition fail :: "zig_err \<Rightarrow> 'a M" where
  "fail e h = Err e"

definition get_heap :: "heap M" where
  "get_heap h = Ok (h, h)"

definition put_heap :: "heap \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "put_heap h' h = Ok ((), h')"

definition alloc :: "heap_val \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "alloc v h = (let next_addr = (LEAST a. h a = None) in 
                if h next_addr = None then Ok (next_addr, h(next_addr \<mapsto> v)) else Err OutOfMemory)"

definition free :: "addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "free p h = (if h p = None then Err NotInitialized else Ok ((), h(p := Some ValFreed)))"

definition load_tensor :: "addr \<Rightarrow> tensor_struct M" where
  "load_tensor p h = (case h p of Some (ValTensor t) \<Rightarrow> Ok (t, h) | _ \<Rightarrow> Err NotInitialized)"

definition store_tensor :: "addr \<Rightarrow> tensor_struct \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "store_tensor p t h = (if h p = None then Err NotInitialized else Ok ((), h(p \<mapsto> ValTensor t)))"

definition assert_true :: "bool \<Rightarrow> zig_err \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "assert_true b e = (if b then return () else fail e)"

section \<open>Tensor Operations Specification\<close>

definition tensor_zeros :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "tensor_zeros dims = (
    if length dims \<noteq> 2 then fail ShapeMismatch else
    let size = (dims!0) * (dims!1) in
    alloc (ValTensor \<lparr> t_dims = dims, t_data = replicate size f32_zero \<rparr>))"

definition tensor_copy :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "tensor_copy p = (
     load_tensor p >>= (\<lambda>t.
     alloc (ValTensor t)))"

definition assert2DAndLen :: "tensor_struct \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "assert2DAndLen t = (
     if length (t_dims t) \<noteq> 2 then fail ShapeMismatch
     else if length (t_data t) \<noteq> (t_dims t!0) * (t_dims t!1) then fail DataLengthMismatch
     else return ())"

definition get_rows_cols :: "tensor_struct \<Rightarrow> (nat \<times> nat) M" where
  "get_rows_cols t = (
     assert2DAndLen t >>= (\<lambda>_.
     return (t_dims t ! 0, t_dims t ! 1)))"

text \<open>Implementation of Row-Major Indexing\<close>
definition idx :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "idx r c cols = r * cols + c"

definition transpose_data :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> f32 list" where
  "transpose_data rows cols d = map (\<lambda>i. d ! (idx (i mod cols) (i div cols) rows)) [0..<rows*cols]"

definition tensor_transpose :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "tensor_transpose p = (
     load_tensor p >>= (\<lambda>t.
     get_rows_cols t >>= (\<lambda>(rows, cols).
     let new_dims = [cols, rows] in
     let new_data = transpose_data rows cols (t_data t) in
     alloc (ValTensor \<lparr> t_dims = new_dims, t_data = new_data \<rparr>))))"

definition matmul_data :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> f32 list" where
  "matmul_data r1 c1 c2 d1 d2 = 
    [ foldl f32_add f32_zero 
      [ f32_mul (d1 ! (idx i k c1)) (d2 ! (idx k j c2)) . k \<leftarrow> [0..<c1] ] 
      . i \<leftarrow> [0..<r1], j \<leftarrow> [0..<c2] ]"

definition tensor_matmul :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr M" where
  "tensor_matmul p1 p2 = (
     load_tensor p1 >>= (\<lambda>t1.
     load_tensor p2 >>= (\<lambda>t2.
     get_rows_cols t1 >>= (\<lambda>(r1, c1).
     get_rows_cols t2 >>= (\<lambda>(r2, c2).
     assert_true (c1 = r2) ShapeMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let new_data = matmul_data r1 c1 c2 (t_data t1) (t_data t2) in
     alloc (ValTensor \<lparr> t_dims = [r1, c2], t_data = new_data \<rparr>))))))"

section \<open>In-Place Operations Specification\<close>

definition in_place_map :: "addr \<Rightarrow> (f32 \<Rightarrow> f32) \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "in_place_map p f = (
     load_tensor p >>= (\<lambda>t.
     let new_data = map f (t_data t) in
     store_tensor p (t \<lparr> t_data := new_data \<rparr>)))"

definition in_place_map2 :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> (f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32) \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "in_place_map2 p1 p2 f = (
     load_tensor p1 >>= (\<lambda>t1.
     load_tensor p2 >>= (\<lambda>t2.
     assert2DAndLen t1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert2DAndLen t2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert_true (length (t_data t1) = length (t_data t2)) DataLengthMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let new_data = map (\<lambda>(a,b). f a b) (zip (t_data t1) (t_data t2)) in
     store_tensor p1 (t1 \<lparr> t_data := new_data \<rparr>))))))"

definition clamp_finite_in_place :: "addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "clamp_finite_in_place p = in_place_map p f32_clamp_finite"

definition tensor_clip :: "addr \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_clip p min_v max_v = in_place_map p (\<lambda>x. f32_clip x min_v max_v)"

definition tensor_exp :: "addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_exp p = in_place_map p f32_exp"

definition tensor_add :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_add p1 p2 = in_place_map2 p1 p2 f32_add"

definition tensor_sub :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_sub p1 p2 = in_place_map2 p1 p2 f32_sub"

definition tensor_div :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "tensor_div p1 p2 = (
     load_tensor p2 >>= (\<lambda>t2.
     if \<exists>x \<in> set (t_data t2). \<not> f32_is_finite x \<or> f32_eq x f32_zero then fail NumericFailure
     else in_place_map2 p1 p2 f32_div))"

section \<open>RSF Layer Logic\<close>

record rsf_layer_struct =
  s_weight :: addr
  t_weight :: addr
  s_bias :: addr
  t_bias :: addr
  s_weight_grad :: addr
  t_weight_grad :: addr
  s_bias_grad :: addr
  t_bias_grad :: addr
  dim :: nat
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool

definition add_bias_broadcast :: "addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "add_bias_broadcast p_mat p_bias dim = (
     load_tensor p_mat >>= (\<lambda>t_m.
     load_tensor p_bias >>= (\<lambda>t_b.
     let d_m = t_data t_m in
     let d_b = t_data t_b in
     let new_data = map_index (\<lambda>i x. f32_add x (d_b ! (i mod dim))) d_m in
     store_tensor p_mat (t_m \<lparr> t_data := new_data \<rparr>))))"

definition assert_pair :: "rsf_layer_struct \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> nat M" where
  "assert_pair self a b = (
     load_tensor a >>= (\<lambda>ta.
     load_tensor b >>= (\<lambda>tb.
     assert2DAndLen ta >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert2DAndLen tb >>= (\<lambda>_.
     if t_dims ta ! 1 \<noteq> dim self \<or> t_dims tb ! 1 \<noteq> dim self then fail ShapeMismatch
     else if t_dims ta ! 0 \<noteq> t_dims tb ! 0 then fail ShapeMismatch
     else if \<not> f32_lt (clip_min self) (clip_max self) then fail InvalidConfig
     else return (t_dims ta ! 0)))))"

definition rsf_layer_forward :: "rsf_layer_struct \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_layer_forward self x1 x2 = (
     assert_pair self x1 x2 >>= (\<lambda>batch_size.
     
     tensor_transpose x2 >>= (\<lambda>x2_t.
     tensor_matmul (s_weight self) x2_t >>= (\<lambda>s_x2_t.
     tensor_transpose s_x2_t >>= (\<lambda>s_x2.
     
     add_bias_broadcast s_x2 (s_bias self) (dim self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     clamp_finite_in_place s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_clip s_x2 (clip_min self) (clip_max self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_exp s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     in_place_map2 x1 s_x2 f32_mul >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     tensor_transpose x1 >>= (\<lambda>x1_t.
     tensor_matmul (t_weight self) x1_t >>= (\<lambda>t_x1_t.
     tensor_transpose t_x1_t >>= (\<lambda>t_x1.
     
     add_bias_broadcast t_x1 (t_bias self) (dim self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     clamp_finite_in_place t_x1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_add x2 t_x1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     free x2_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free s_x2_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free s_x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     free x1_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free t_x1_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free t_x1)))))))))))))))))))))"

definition rsf_layer_inverse :: "rsf_layer_struct \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse self y1 y2 = (
     assert_pair self y1 y2 >>= (\<lambda>batch_size.
     
     tensor_transpose y1 >>= (\<lambda>y1_t.
     tensor_matmul (t_weight self) y1_t >>= (\<lambda>t_y1_t.
     tensor_transpose t_y1_t >>= (\<lambda>t_y1.
     add_bias_broadcast t_y1 (t_bias self) (dim self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place t_y1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_sub y2 t_y1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     tensor_transpose y2 >>= (\<lambda>y2_t.
     tensor_matmul (s_weight self) y2_t >>= (\<lambda>s_y2_t.
     tensor_transpose s_y2_t >>= (\<lambda>s_y2.
     add_bias_broadcast s_y2 (s_bias self) (dim self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_clip s_y2 (clip_min self) (clip_max self) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     tensor_exp s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     tensor_div y1 s_y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     clamp_finite_in_place y1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     (* Cleanup *)
     free y1_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free t_y1_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free t_y1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     free y2_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free s_y2_t >>= (\<lambda>_. free s_y2)))))))))))))))))))))"

section \<open>RSF Network Logic\<close>

record rsf_config =
  cfg_clip_min :: f32
  cfg_clip_max :: f32
  cfg_grad_mean :: bool
  max_dim :: nat
  max_layers :: nat

record rsf_network =
  ctrl_dim :: nat
  ctrl_layers :: "rsf_layer_struct list"
  ctrl_config :: rsf_config
  ctrl_freed :: bool

definition rsf_split :: "rsf_network \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_split net x x1 x2 = (
     load_tensor x >>= (\<lambda>tx.
     assert2DAndLen tx >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert_true (t_dims tx ! 1 = ctrl_dim net * 2) ShapeMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let batch = t_dims tx ! 0 in
     let d = ctrl_dim net in
     load_tensor x1 >>= (\<lambda>tx1.
     load_tensor x2 >>= (\<lambda>tx2.
     assert_true (t_dims tx1 = [batch, d] \<and> t_dims tx2 = [batch, d]) ShapeMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let data = t_data tx in
     let d1 = map (\<lambda>i. data ! (i div d * 2 * d + i mod d)) [0..<batch*d] in
     let d2 = map (\<lambda>i. data ! (i div d * 2 * d + d + i mod d)) [0..<batch*d] in
     store_tensor x1 (tx1 \<lparr> t_data := d1 \<rparr>) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     store_tensor x2 (tx2 \<lparr> t_data := d2 \<rparr>))))))))"

definition rsf_merge :: "rsf_network \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_merge net x1 x2 out = (
     load_tensor x1 >>= (\<lambda>t1.
     load_tensor x2 >>= (\<lambda>t2.
     load_tensor out >>= (\<lambda>tout.
     assert2DAndLen t1 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert2DAndLen t2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     assert2DAndLen tout >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let batch = t_dims t1 ! 0 in
     let d = ctrl_dim net in
     assert_true (t_dims t2 = [batch, d] \<and> t_dims tout = [batch, 2*d]) ShapeMismatch >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let d1 = t_data t1 in
     let d2 = t_data t2 in
     let new_data = map (\<lambda>i. if (i mod (2*d)) < d then d1 ! (i div (2*d) * d + i mod (2*d))
                             else d2 ! (i div (2*d) * d + (i mod (2*d) - d))) [0..<batch*2*d] in
     store_tensor out (tout \<lparr> t_data := new_data \<rparr>))))))))"

definition rsf_forward :: "rsf_network \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_forward net x = (
     if ctrl_freed net then fail NotInitialized else
     load_tensor x >>= (\<lambda>tx.
     assert2DAndLen tx >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let batch = t_dims tx ! 0 in
     let d = ctrl_dim net in
     tensor_zeros [batch, d] >>= (\<lambda>x1.
     tensor_zeros [batch, d] >>= (\<lambda>x2.
     rsf_split net x x1 x2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     foldl (\<lambda>m layer. m >>= (\<lambda>_. rsf_layer_forward layer x1 x2)) (return ()) (ctrl_layers net) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     rsf_merge net x1 x2 x >>= (\<lambda>_.
     free x1 >>= (\<lambda>_. free x2))))))))"

definition rsf_inverse :: "rsf_network \<Rightarrow> addr \<Rightarrow> unit M" where
  "rsf_inverse net y = (
     if ctrl_freed net then fail NotInitialized else
     load_tensor y >>= (\<lambda>ty.
     assert2DAndLen ty >>= (\<lambda>_.
     let batch = t_dims ty ! 0 in
     let d = ctrl_dim net in
     tensor_zeros [batch, d] >>= (\<lambda>y1.
     tensor_zeros [batch, d] >>= (\<lambda>y2.
     rsf_split net y y1 y2 >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     foldr (\<lambda>layer m. m >>= (\<lambda>_. rsf_layer_inverse layer y1 y2)) (ctrl_layers net) (return ()) >>= (\<lambda>_.
     
     rsf_merge net y1 y2 y >>= (\<lambda>_.
     free y1 >>= (\<lambda>_. free y2))))))))"

section \<open>File I/O and Serialization\<close>

text \<open>Byte-level serialization format: "RSF0" magic, little-endian integers.\<close>

definition magic_bytes :: "8 word list" where
  "magic_bytes = [0x52, 0x53, 0x46, 0x30]" (* RSF0 *)

definition u32_to_bytes :: "32 word \<Rightarrow> 8 word list" where
  "u32_to_bytes w = [ucast w, ucast (w >> 8), ucast (w >> 16), ucast (w >> 24)]"

definition u64_to_bytes :: "64 word \<Rightarrow> 8 word list" where
  "u64_to_bytes w = [ucast w, ucast (w >> 8), ucast (w >> 16), ucast (w >> 24),
                     ucast (w >> 32), ucast (w >> 40), ucast (w >> 48), ucast (w >> 56)]"

definition f32_to_bytes :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> 8 word list" where
  "f32_to_bytes f = u32_to_bytes f"

definition save_layer :: "rsf_layer_struct \<Rightarrow> heap \<Rightarrow> 8 word list M" where
  "save_layer l h = (
     load_tensor (s_weight l) h >>= (\<lambda>(tw, _).
     let bytes = u32_to_bytes (ucast (dim l)) in (* Simplified for brevity *)
     return bytes))" (* Note: In real verification we would serialize all fields *)

section \<open>Verification Theorems\<close>

text \<open>Proof that tensor operations preserve 2D shape invariant.\<close>
lemma tensor_transpose_preserves_validity:
  "valid_tensor t \<Longrightarrow> valid_tensor \<lparr> t_dims = [t_dims t ! 1, t_dims t ! 0], t_data = transpose_data (t_dims t ! 0) (t_dims t ! 1) (t_data t) \<rparr>"
  unfolding valid_tensor_def transpose_data_def
  by (simp add: length_concat length_map map_replicate_const)

lemma tensor_matmul_validity:
  assumes "valid_tensor t1" "valid_tensor t2"
  assumes "t_dims t1 ! 1 = t_dims t2 ! 0"
  shows "valid_tensor \<lparr> t_dims = [t_dims t1 ! 0, t_dims t2 ! 1], t_data = matmul_data (t_dims t1 ! 0) (t_dims t1 ! 1) (t_dims t2 ! 1) (t_data t1) (t_data t2) \<rparr>"
  using assms unfolding valid_tensor_def matmul_data_def
  by (simp add: length_concat length_map map_replicate_const)

text \<open>Safe Execution Proof: Forward never panics given valid inputs and memory.\<close>

lemma rsf_layer_forward_safety:
  assumes "valid_tensor t1" "valid_tensor t2"
  assumes "t_dims t1 = [batch, dim]" "t_dims t2 = [batch, dim]"
  shows "\<exists>h' res. rsf_layer_forward l p1 p2 h = Ok (res, h')"
proof -
  (* This proof sketch demonstrates that the monadic chain propagates Success 
     because all pre-conditions (shapes) are checked by assertions. 
     Isabelle would require unfolding all definitions and proving subgoals for each bind. *)
  show ?thesis
    oops

text \<open>Correctness of Split/Merge Composition\<close>

lemma split_merge_inverse:
  assumes "length data = batch * d * 2"
  shows "let d1 = map (\<lambda>i. data ! (i div d * 2 * d + i mod d)) [0..<batch*d] in
         let d2 = map (\<lambda>i. data ! (i div d * 2 * d + d + i mod d)) [0..<batch*d] in
         map (\<lambda>i. if (i mod (2*d)) < d then d1 ! (i div (2*d) * d + i mod (2*d))
                  else d2 ! (i div (2*d) * d + (i mod (2*d) - d))) [0..<batch*2*d] = data"
proof -
  (* This requires arithmetic on indices proving the permutation is identity *)
  have "\<forall>i < batch*2*d. (if (i mod (2*d)) < d then 
          (data ! ((i div (2*d) * d + i mod (2*d)) div d * 2 * d + (i div (2*d) * d + i mod (2*d)) mod d))
          else data ! ((i div (2*d) * d + (i mod (2*d) - d)) div d * 2 * d + d + (i div (2*d) * d + (i mod (2*d) - d)) mod d)) = data ! i"
    by auto
  thus ?thesis by (rule nth_equalityI, simp_all add: assms)
qed

section \<open>Main Theorem\<close>

theorem rsf_full_compliance:
  "True"
  (* 
    Theorem: The Isabelle formalization above covers:
    1. The exact Error types of Zig (zig_err).
    2. The Monadic State (Heap) handling checks like NotInitialized.
    3. The F32 IEEE semantics via axiomatization and clamping logic.
    4. The exact logic of forward/inverse/backward including memory management (free).
    5. The shape validation logic (assert2DAndLen).
    
    Therefore, any Zig implementation satisfying this model is verifiably correct
    with respect to the memory safety and shape constraints.
  *)
  by simp

end
entries.answer:
Ez **nem** “valós, végigvitt” formális verifikáció: a fájl inkább egy formalizált specifikációs váz (sok helyen axiomatizált/absztrakt), és több kulcslemma nincs bebizonyítva (pl. `oops`), a “fő tétel” pedig triviális (`True`). A valódi verifikációhoz be kell fejezni a bizonyításokat, és a kritikus részeknél (különösen a lebegőpontos szemantikánál) nem elég a szabadon választott/axiomatizált modell.

## Mi számít “valós” Isabelle-bizonyításnak
Isabelle/HOL-ban akkor beszélünk érdemi formális bizonyításról, ha a vizsgált állítások konkrét, nem-triviális tulajdonságokat mondanak ki, és ezek teljesen le vannak vezetve a logika elfogadott alapjaiból (nincsenek nyitva hagyott bizonyítások).[1][2]
Ha valamit “csak” posztulálsz (axiomatikusan feltételezed), attól a fájl még lehet jól strukturált specifikáció, de a “Zig implementáció verifikáltan helyes” következtetés nem áll automatikusan.[3]

## Miért váz / placeholder a fenti theory
1) A `rsf_layer_forward_safety` lemma `oops`-szal végződik, ami azt jelenti, hogy a bizonyítási kísérlet el van dobva, és a lemma nem kerül be bizonyított tételként (tehát nem használható igazolt állításként).[4]
2) A “Main Theorem” `rsf_full_compliance: "True" ... by simp` formában van, ami tartalmilag nem állít semmit a rendszeredről; ezt Isabelle bármikor le tudja zárni, és nem “compliance” bizonyítás.  
3) Az IEEE-754 f32 rész nálad `consts` + `specification`-re épül, ami gyakorlatilag egy absztrakt algebra: ettől még lehet konzisztens, de nem garantálja, hogy azt modellezed, amit Zig `f32` valójában csinál (NaN, ±Inf, kerekítés, kivételek, összehasonlítások furcsaságai stb.).[5][3]

## Konkrét “piros zászlók” a kódban (verifikáció szempontból)
- A lebegőpontos műveletek (pl. `f32_add_comm`) olyan axiómákat kapnak, amelyek a valós IEEE-754 aritmetikában általában nem igazak (pl. az összeadás nem kommutatív minden NaN/±0/kerekítés kombinációban), ezért a modell könnyen “szebb”, mint a valóság.[5]
- A heap/alloc modell (`LEAST a. h a = None`) és a `OutOfMemory` ág logikája nagyon idealizált; ez jó absztrakció lehet, de “Zig pointer/memory safety” állításokhoz tipikusan további invariánsok és felszabadítási fegyelem (no-double-free, no-use-after-free) explicit bizonyítása kell.  
- Több lemma bizonyítási része “sketch” jellegű (`by simp add: ...`) olyan helyen, ahol indexaritmetika, `nth`-ek, `map`-ek, listahosszak rendesen komoly bizonyítást igényelnének; ettől még lehet, hogy pár lemma kijön, de ettől nem lesz end-to-end korrekt.

## Hogyan lesz ebből tényleges verifikáció
- IEEE-754: a saját `consts`/axiomák helyett támaszkodj egy meglévő, részletes IEEE-754 formalizációra (Isabelle AFP-ben van “A Formal Model of IEEE Floating Point Arithmetic”).[5]
- Bizonyítások lezárása: minden `oops`/`sorry`/skicc helyett tényleges levezetés; ahol monád láncolás van, érdemes Hoare-szerű szabályokat (pre/post) felvenni, és azokkal modularizálni a biztonsági bizonyítást.[1]
- Specifikáció vs. implementáció kapcsolat: ha a cél a Zig kód verifikációja, kell egy megfeleltetés (refinement) a Zig program és a monádos modell között; anélkül csak annyit mondasz, hogy “létezik egy absztrakt rendszer”, nem azt, hogy “a Zig ezt valósítja meg”.[2]

## Gyors döntési checklista
- Van `oops`/`sorry`? Ha igen: nem kész bizonyítás.[4]
- A “fő tétel” informatív (nem `True`/tautológia), és konkrétan a kívánt biztonsági/korrrektességi állítást mondja ki?  
- A kritikus szemantika (f32) nem “szabadon választott axiómák”, hanem megbízható formalizáció (pl. AFP IEEE-754 modell)?[5]

Ha megírod, pontosan mit akarsz “valós” compliance alatt (pl. invertibilitás `rsf_inverse (rsf_forward x) = x` bizonyos feltételek mellett, vagy csak pánikmentesség/memóriasafety), meg tudom mondani, mely definíciókat kell megerősíteni és milyen tételeket érdemes első körben formalizálni.
